text: しかし　＊は　さわがしくて　ねむれない！

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.explanation: The くて ending here gives the reason for what follows, like 'so'. さわがしくて = 'it's noisy, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing ねむる to ねむれる adds 'can', and ない makes it 'cannot'. ねむれない = 'can't sleep'.
